request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
Can I use my encrypted USB stick to hand files to a client at their office tomorrow?

Employee: Financial Analyst, Finance, London; ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (Windows 11).

Why the automated desk stopped: Decide did not clear it for self-service (escalate is 93% likely).

What the automated desk already did: screened the ticket and masked personal data; classified it as uncategorised, low severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 2 passages; drafted a reply and verified it (100% grounded).

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
Writing files to any USB storage device, encrypted or not, is blocked on company laptops.
1. Share files with clients through a secure share link from OneDrive with an expiry date.
2. Exceptions need a security exception approved by the Security team
